capability: Sites and routes of a headless storefront channel (BigCommerce: Sites & Routes, Sites)
note: The site a headless storefront channel is served at, and the routes of its pages. BigCommerce gives it an API group of its own (Sites, /developer/api-reference/rest/admin/management/sites: "Create and manage sites and routes for headless storefront sales channels", BC-S-0231), an access scope (store_sites, BC-S-0232) and webhook topics for sites and routes (BC-S-0233, BC-I-0263). Under CM-SFR-011 because BigCommerce's statement puts sites and routes with headless storefront channels (BC-S-0231). Not CM-SFR-008 (store domains), a reading: no statement held says what a site's URL is made of or that a domain is bought or connected through it. BigCommerce only so far.

capability: Several storefronts in one store (BigCommerce: Multi-Storefront, MSF)
note: The ability to run more than one storefront on one store's back end. BigCommerce defines it: "“Multi-Storefront” or “MSF” means the ability to manage multiple unique Storefronts within one Store" (BC-S-0227), and gives it a plan line of its own, Multi-storefront, with a price and a maximum per plan (BC-S-0228). Under CM-CHN-001, a reading: BigCommerce counts a headless storefront as a channel (BC-S-0220) and puts multi-storefront beside multi-channel support (BC-S-0229). Not CM-MKS-001 (Markets): the anchor's Markets is a version of the store for the buyers of a place (country, region, city), and no statement of BC-C-039 ties a storefront to a place. Not domain A's CM-ACC-003 (several stores under one owner): MSF is several storefronts within one store (BC-S-0227). BigCommerce only so far; the coordinator may prefer area SFR, since the thing multiplied is the storefront.
